d:
A 27-year-old Indian man, Bilal Kazi, has been sentenced to 30 years in prison in the UK for grooming and sexually exploiting young girls online. Posing as a 14-year-old boy named Reece, he used social media and gaming platforms to gain their trust, obtain explicit images and blackmail them. Police identified 70 victims and 180 potential victims in the investigation.
